extracted_concepts.name: Place Value System
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: System describing the value of each digit based on its positional power of ten.

extracted_concepts.name: Multi-digit Multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fluently multiplying whole numbers with multiple digits using standard algorithms.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimal Arithmetic
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing decimals to the hundredths place.

extracted_concepts.name: Fraction Division
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Interpreting division as numerator divided by denominator; dividing fractions by fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: Measurement Unit Conversion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Converting among different-sized standard measurement units within a system.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantifying 3D space; relating volume to multiplication and addition.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate Plane
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two-dimensional grid used to locate points using ordered pairs.

extracted_concepts.name: Two-dimensional Figures
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometric shapes classified into categories based on their defining properties.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Comparison of two quantities expressing a multiplicative relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate associated with ratios of fractions, computed per single unit of the second quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest Common Factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Largest positive integer that divides two or more numbers without a remainder.

extracted_concepts.name: Least Common Multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Smallest positive integer divisible by two or more given numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Algebraic Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical phrases combining variables, constants, and arithmetic operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation Solving
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of reasoning to determine variable values that satisfy a given equation.

extracted_concepts.name: Polygon Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Calculating the surface extent of triangles, trapezoids, and other polygons.

extracted_concepts.name: Rectangular Prism Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding volume of right rectangular prisms, including those with fractional edge lengths.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Net
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 2D pattern that can be folded to form a 3D figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical Question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Question anticipated to yield variability in data when answered.

extracted_concepts.name: Data Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summary describing how data values are spread, clustered, or centered.

extracted_concepts.name: Measure of Center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statistic representing the typical or central value of a dataset, such as mean or median.

extracted_concepts.name: Measure of Variation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statistic describing the spread or variability of a dataset, such as range or IQR.

extracted_relations.evidence: Understanding place value is foundational for fluently multiplying multi-digit numbers.
Decimal operations directly apply and extend the base ten place value system.
Core chain links fractions to decimals; fraction-to-decimal conversion supports decimal operations.
Simplifying fraction division results often relies on finding common factors.
Converting measurement units is necessary before calculating or relating volume accurately.
Text states 'Relate volume to multiplication'; volume calculation uses multi-digit multiplication.
Nets represent 3D figures like rectangular prisms whose volume is calculated.
Graphing points on the coordinate plane is used to classify and plot 2D figures.
Finding area is a key property-based classification task for 2D figures like triangles and trapezoids.
Unit rates are specific ratios where the second term is normalized to one.
Core chain connects decimals to ratios; unit rates often use decimal calculations.
Solving ratio problems often involves setting up and evaluating algebraic expressions.
Core chain explicitly links expressions to equations; solving equations builds on expression evaluation.
Core chain ends with statistics; equations model relationships within statistical data.
Recognizing statistical questions is the prerequisite step to summarizing and describing distributions.
Measures of center summarize the central tendency of a data distribution.
Measures of variation describe the spread within a data distribution.
Both are fundamental number system concepts used for fraction operations and simplification.
